expected_cases.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record

expected_cases.charges: Obstructing traffic while picketing segregated Canal Street stores in New Orleans
expected_cases.sentence: Refused bail and remained jailed after the April 17, 1961 picketing arrest. Exact release date unverified. Smith subsequently testified that he served thirty days for the April picketing.

case.sentence: CORE records identify his jailing during the December 1961 Baton Rouge demonstrations. Exact admission and release days remain unverified. Smith testified that he served twenty-one days.
